newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) higher.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) higher.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Wednesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
The central bank does not post volumes.
Traders said short-term financial centres, money brokerages run by the central bank, were the major borrowers today.

Despite rises today, the rates would meet downward pressure in the next few days, with banks and other financial institutions having more money to offer with the end today of the issue of the seven-year bond, they said.
The bond will be listed on Thursday, enabling the institutions to trade and take back money they have deposited to underwrite the bond, they said.
"Banks and other institutions will have more money to lend out on the market in the next few day," said one trader.
